reviewer.scope: Local read-only source/reference/protocol review; only this JSON and companion Markdown written. No source/config changes, Git submission, remote access or inference.

decision: PASS for reference data and prospective protocol as inspected. The running local driver must load the updated implementation before its next affected freeze; this audit does not claim that restart has already occurred.
summary_zh: strict即时选择参考仅改变背景尺度估计的时间范围；真实受控节点的即时选择目标、原始物理均值、去除ridge并还原后的经验协方差和ESS保持一致。实际正则化后的物理协方差及奖励可能改变，不能称控制等价。

checked_scope.outside_frame: score=.5 -> proposal=.51 retained as context. In the instantaneous reference it retains its same-event selected moments, but contributes neither to scale quadrature nor any actual reward injection.
checked_scope.source_policy: Only discovery trajectories0–13; no actual t=1 label or validation/heldout result used to construct/review targets.

independent_raw_audit.method: Independently select resampled events by actual state_time within the learned window; recompute motif primitives from raw proposal coordinates, detached forecast labels/anchors and masks. Use channel-specific finite masks. Compute unweighted candidate population variance(ddof0) per event/batch, equal-batch mean and manual normalized trapezoidal score-time quadrature.
independent_raw_audit.scale_formula: s_j^2 = sum_k w_k * mean_b Var_unweighted(phi_(b,k,j)); k = score0… .49, w=normalized trapezoid. Instantaneous target uses normalized same-event selection_probability, not descendant counts.
independent_raw_audit.hashes: All14 raw trajectory byte hashes matched the reference source hashes.
independent_raw_audit.error_interpretation: Raw recomputation against the NEW reference confirms its implementation. Dimensionless covariance errors here compare the same new scale/ridge; they do not claim old and new regularized physical covariances are identical.

historical_parity.comparison: Old all/cross references versus new strict all/cross; all51 stored frames x14 batches x selected/background =1428 moment pairs per channel, including every actually controlled node.
historical_parity.selection_weights: Old selected_probability_ESS and new target_weight_ESS are semantically the same quantity for instantaneous references; values matched exactly, availability and n_available also matched.
historical_parity.raw_covariance_reconstruction: Given dimensionless regularized Creg=.9*C+.1*diag(C)+.01I, subtract .01 from the diagonal and divide off-diagonals by .9, then multiply by outer(feature_scale,feature_scale). Only this reconstructed empirical physical covariance is compared across versions.
historical_parity.crucial_distinction: Actual regularized physical covariance = .9*Cphys+.1*diag(Cphys)+.01*diag(s_j^2). The last term changes with strict scale, so precision, reward, dose gate and resulting trajectories need not remain equal despite unchanged raw targets.
historical_parity.survival_parity: For each channel, strict instantaneous feature_scale is exactly equal to the already-corrected boundary_survival scale; only target weights/moments differ.
historical_parity.historical_freeze: R1–8 reference hashes remain their original values. R1–9 program byte hashes still match their frozen plan records; R9 keeps its already-dispatched corrected survival reference unchanged.
historical_parity.sidecars: Both strict compressed-file SHA256 and byte size match their manifest sidecars.

protocol_review.declared_before: R11/R12 dispatch and R13–15 validation/heldout evaluation; the design ledger contains an explicit prospective strict-normalization revision.
protocol_review.R11: Restore the completed balanced Pareto parent; halve its dose. If its target is instantaneous, route to the matching strict all/cross reference.
protocol_review.R12: Restore the completed affinity Pareto parent; set time_ramp_power=1. If its target is instantaneous, route to the matching strict all/cross reference.
protocol_review.factor_interpretation: If the restored parent used historical normalization, scale/ridge and dose or ramp both change. This is not a single-factor causal ablation. If the parent already uses strict normalization, replacement is numerically a no-op; record the actual frozen program/reference diff rather than asserting two numerical factors changed in every case.
protocol_review.R13: Selection pool is explicitly restricted to discovery rounds9–12. Their comparisons remain development data; R1–8 may motivate restored architectures but cannot directly become the final strict-scope winner.
protocol_review.R14_R15: Use round13.plan.parent_round and copy that same discovery program. Validation/heldout scores are not fed back into choose(); only round/run metadata and evaluation batches change.
protocol_review.scope_gate: For number>=9, freeze rejects references without scale_score_times or whose last scale score reaches the learning-window end. The inspected references additionally passed the full actual-state grid and source checks above.
interpretation_limits: Pareto/choose always returning a candidate does not prove a jointly improving solution; feasibility fallback must remain visible in the final report.

Current seed42 batch splits are prospective tests for this campaign, not new-master-seed generalization. Historical aggregate access in earlier work prevents a blanket claim that all prior context was fully blinded.
This review did not inspect R13–15 outcomes. Their plan files were not yet present at the snapshot, so protocol consistency is a source/ledger audit, not proof of future execution.

execution_action.finding: MotifDriver is a persistent loop; proposal is imported at process start. Editing files or pulling Git does not replace already-loaded Python functions.
execution_action.owner_plan: Owner confirmed a controlled restart of the local driver during detached R10 inference; the remote inference and its frozen reference remain unchanged.
execution_action.status: Required adoption step acknowledged, not performed or independently confirmed by this reviewer. Restart/resume and subsequent freeze hashes should be recorded by the owner.
execution_action.tests: Owner reports185 local tests passed. This reviewer did not rerun the suite; the700-frame/channel independent numerical audit was executed.

provenance.hash_semantics: Exact local bytes at audit snapshot; later intentional code/ledger changes require a new recorded hash, not a claim that this snapshot already reviewed them.
